Regular price $12.00 Sale price $12.00 Regular price Unit price per On farm killing and processing Contact Wild Game or fill in a booking(link) form for your animals. 2Farm-kill One of the wild game team will contact you to organize a time to come and do the on Farm-kill of your animal. 3Processing One of our Highly Skilled Farm-kill Operators will come and Dispatch the animal Humanely, Dress out and then Deliver to the Wild Game HQ where it will be aged before cutting. 4Cutting Information You can Fill in a Cut sheet (link) or you can Contact one of the Team at Wild Game to go over how you would like your animal cut. We ensure we cut the animal to suit each and every customer. WE NEED YOU INFORMATION within 1 day of the animal arriving at wild game. This ensures no delay in our production. Once all your meat is completed one of the Wild Game Team will Contact you with a Price and when you are able to collect. All meat MUST BE paid for when collected. If your meat is going on an account this must be paid prior to picking up. All our meat is weighed back to the customer for full transparency of what we have processed for you.
